title: Parts of the body
about: The names of the parts of the body: head and face, arms and legs, the rest of the body and inside the body. Also special plurals (foot – feet, tooth – teeth), hair as a singular word, and my / your / her with parts of the body.

parts.title: Pronunciation problems
parts.note: Ці слова часто вимовляють неправильно. Послухай кожне і повтори вголос кілька разів.

rows: k не читається, як у know, knife.
ea тут як a в car, не «хеарт».
oo тут як u в cup: «блад», без довгого «у».
Довге u і th у кінці.

parts.title: Singular and plurals
parts.note: Деякі слова мають особливу множину: foot — feet, tooth — teeth (не foots, tooths). Hair — однина: My hair is long. I must wash it (не hairs are, не them).

rows: I brush my teeth twice a day.
My hair is wet. I'm drying it.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: З частинами тіла англійською зазвичай кажуть my, your, his, her, our, their — навіть там, де українською займенника немає: She's washing her hair (не the hair). I've got a pain in my leg (не in the leg).

rows: I've got a pain in my leg. / My leg hurts.

items.pattern: hair (singular): my hair is … · long / short / curly hair · wash / brush your hair
items.meaning: the soft things that grow on your head
items.example: My sister has got long **hair**.
more: I wash my **hair** every morning before school.
Your **hair** looks great! Did you cut it?
items.watchOut: Hair — однина: My hair is long (не my hairs are). Про волосся кажуть it: I must wash it. Hairs — це окремі волосинки: There are cat hairs on the sofa.

items.pattern: an eye · two eyes · blue / brown eyes · close your eyes
items.meaning: you see with it
items.example: My baby brother has got big blue **eyes**.
more: Close your **eyes** and make a wish!
I've got something in my **eye**. It hurts.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /aɪ/, так само, як I (я). Колір очей: She has got brown eyes (не «eyes of brown colour»).

items.pattern: a nose · blow your nose · breathe through your nose
items.meaning: the part of your face you smell and breathe with
items.example: My baby sister has got a tiny **nose**.
more: The clown has got a big red **nose**.
Breathe in slowly through your **nose**.

items.pattern: one tooth · two teeth · brush your teeth
items.meaning: the hard white things in your mouth; you bite and eat with them
items.example: Brush your **teeth** before bed.
more: My little sister has lost her first **tooth**.
I'm going to the dentist because my **tooth** hurts.
items.watchOut: Множина — teeth, не tooths. Чистити зуби — brush your teeth (у Британії ще кажуть clean your teeth).

items.pattern: an ear · two ears · in your ear
items.meaning: you hear with it
items.example: Rabbits have got long **ears**.
more: She whispered a secret in my **ear**.
Elephants move their big **ears** to stay cool.

items.pattern: a mouth · open / close your mouth · in your mouth
items.meaning: the part of your face you eat and speak with
items.example: The baby put a toy in her **mouth**.
more: Our dog always has a ball in its **mouth**.
I always smile with my **mouth** closed in photos.
items.watchOut: Не плутай mouth /maʊθ/ (рот) і mouse /maʊs/ (миша): у кінці mouth — звук th.

items.pattern: a lip · lips · top / bottom lip
items.meaning: one of the two soft edges of your mouth
items.example: It's very cold and my **lips** are dry.
more: I bit my **lip** by accident when I was eating.
The baby has got milk on her top **lip**.

items.pattern: a neck · around your neck
items.meaning: the part of your body between your head and your shoulders
items.example: Giraffes have got very long **necks**.
more: The cat has got a little bell around its **neck**.
Sit up straight, or your **neck** will hurt.

items.pattern: a shoulder · on your shoulder(s)
items.meaning: the top part of your body between your neck and your arm
items.example: She put her hand on my **shoulder** and smiled.
more: After swimming, my **shoulders** were tired.
My parrot likes to sit on my **shoulder**.
items.watchOut: Shoulder — це верхня точка, де рука з'єднується з тілом. Частину руки від плеча до ліктя зазвичай називають upper arm.

items.pattern: a nail · cut your nails · fingernail / toenail
items.meaning: the hard flat part at the end of a finger or toe
items.example: My mum cuts my little brother's **nails** every week.
more: She painted her **nails** pink for the party.
I broke a **nail** when I opened the box.
items.watchOut: Nail — ще й цвях. Ніготь на руці точніше — fingernail, на нозі — toenail.

items.pattern: a thumb · thumbs up
items.meaning: the short thick finger at the side of your hand
items.example: The baby is sucking her **thumb**.
more: He gave me a **thumbs** up: everything was OK.
I hurt my **thumb** when I closed the door.
items.watchOut: Великий палець руки — thumb, не big finger. Великий палець ноги — big toe. Вимова /θʌm/: b у кінці не читається.

items.pattern: a finger · five fingers · little finger
items.meaning: one of the long thin parts at the end of your hand
items.example: Count on your **fingers**: one, two, three…
more: I cut my **finger** when I was making a salad.
Don't eat spaghetti with your **fingers**! Use a fork.
items.watchOut: Українською «палець» — і на руці, і на нозі. Англійською палець руки — finger, палець ноги — toe.

items.pattern: a hand · wash your hands · in your hand
items.meaning: the part at the end of your arm, with fingers
items.example: Wash your **hands** after you play with the dog.
more: Put up your **hand** if you know the answer.
She was holding an ice cream in her **hand**.
items.watchOut: Українське «рука» — це і hand (кисть), і arm (від плеча до кисті). Тримати в руці — in your hand.

items.pattern: an arm · break your arm · in your arms
items.meaning: the long part of your body from your shoulder to your hand
items.example: Tom fell off his bike and broke his **arm**.
more: Swimmers have got strong **arms**.
Put your **arms** up and stretch.
items.watchOut: Arm — уся рука від плеча, hand — тільки кисть. «Він зламав руку» зазвичай перекладають he broke his arm.

items.pattern: a leg · break your leg · long legs
items.meaning: one of the two long parts of your body that you walk with
items.example: My **legs** are tired after the football match.
more: Spiders have got eight **legs**.
She broke her **leg** skiing, so she stayed at home for a week.
items.watchOut: Українське «нога» — це і leg (уся нога), і foot (стопа). Наступити на ногу — step on sb's foot.

items.pattern: a knee · on your knees · hurt your knee
items.meaning: the part in the middle of your leg where it bends
items.example: I fell in the playground and hurt my **knee**.
more: Her skirt comes down to her **knees**.
Football players sometimes have problems with their **knees**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /niː/, k не читається (як у know, knife).

items.pattern: one foot · two feet · on foot
items.meaning: the part at the end of your leg that you stand on
items.example: My **feet** hurt after the long walk.
more: Take off your shoes and put your **feet** up.
Ducks have got orange **feet**.
items.watchOut: Множина — feet, не foots. Пішки — on foot. Вимова /fʊt/: коротке u, як у good.

items.pattern: a toe · ten toes · big toe · little toe
items.meaning: one of the five small parts at the end of your foot
items.example: The sea is so cold! I only put one **toe** in.
more: I dropped a book on my **toe**. It really hurts!
Babies love to play with their **toes**.
items.watchOut: Палець ноги — toe, не finger. Великий палець ноги — big toe.

items.pattern: a chest · a pain in your chest
items.meaning: the front of your body between your neck and your stomach
items.example: The doctor listened to my **chest**.
more: I've got a bad cough and my **chest** hurts.
Dad has got hair on his **chest**.
items.watchOut: Груди — chest (у чоловіків і в жінок), і це однина: my chest hurts.

items.pattern: your side · on your side · a pain in your side
items.meaning: the left or right part of your body, between your arm and your hip
items.example: I laughed so much that my **sides** hurt.
more: After running I had a pain in my **side**.
My little brother poked me in the **side**.
items.watchOut: «Біль у боці» — a pain in my side, з my (зазвичай не in the side).

items.pattern: a stomach · stomach ache · on a full / empty stomach
items.meaning: the part inside your body where food goes; also the front of your body below your chest
items.example: I ate too much cake and now my **stomach** hurts.
more: Don't go swimming on a full **stomach**.
Lie on your **stomach** and lift your legs.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈstʌmək/: ch читається як k — «стамек». Біль у животі — stomach ache.

items.pattern: your back · on your back · a pain in your back
items.meaning: the part of your body behind you, from your neck to your bottom
items.example: My **back** hurts after carrying that heavy box.
more: Lie on your **back** and look at the stars.
My school bag is very heavy on my **back**.
items.watchOut: «Болить спина» — my back hurts / I've got a pain in my back (не in the back). Back — ще й «назад»: come back.

items.pattern: a waist · round your waist
items.meaning: the middle of your body, where you wear a belt
items.example: These jeans are too big round the **waist**.
more: She tied her jumper round her **waist**.
The water was up to my **waist**, so I could walk in it.
items.watchOut: Waist звучить так само, як waste (марнувати), але пишеться по-різному.

items.pattern: a hip · two hips · hands on your hips
items.meaning: the part at each side of your body where your legs join it
items.example: She stood with her hands on her **hips**.
more: My grandma has a problem with her **hip**, so she walks slowly.
Move your **hips** to the music!
items.watchOut: Hip — бокова частина тіла біля таза, а не вся верхня частина ноги. Передню частину ноги над коліном називають thigh.

items.pattern: skin (usually no a) · dry / soft skin
items.meaning: the outside cover of your body
items.example: Put on sun cream to protect your **skin**.
more: Babies have very soft **skin**.
Elephants have got thick grey **skin**.
items.watchOut: Шкіра тіла — skin. Шкіра для сумок і взуття — leather: a leather bag.

items.pattern: a heart · your heart beats
items.meaning: the organ in your chest that sends blood around your body
items.example: Your **heart** is on the left side of your chest.
more: Doctors say sport is good for your **heart**.
She drew a red **heart** on the birthday card.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /hɑːt/, ea тут як a в car. Не «хеарт» і не як hear.

items.pattern: a brain · use your brain
items.meaning: the organ in your head that you think with
items.example: Chess is good exercise for your **brain**.
more: Dolphins have got big **brains**.
Come on, use your **brain**! You know the answer.

items.pattern: blood (no a) · a blood test
items.meaning: the red liquid that moves around your body
items.example: The nurse took some **blood** for a test.
more: There was **blood** on his knee after he fell.
The colour of **blood** is dark red.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /blʌd/, oo тут як u в cup — «блад», без довгого «у».

warmup.explain: Мити голову — wash your hair. Hair — однина, тому без -s.

warmup.q: My grandma has got a pain in ___ back.
warmup.explain: З частинами тіла кажуть my, your, her…: a pain in her back.

warmup.uk: У мене болять два зуби. Мені потрібен стоматолог.
warmup.q: Two of my ___ hurt. I need a dentist.
warmup.explain: Один зуб — tooth, два зуби — teeth.

warmup.uk: У мене великі ноги — мені потрібне дуже велике взуття.
warmup.q: I've got big ___. I need very big shoes.
warmup.explain: Нога-стопа — foot, множина — feet. Legs — уся нога, розмір взуття тут ні до чого.
Тримати в руці — in your hand (кисть). Arm — рука від плеча.

warmup.uk: Я наткнувся на ніжку столу і забив палець на нозі.
warmup.q: I walked into the table leg and hurt my ___.
warmup.explain: Палець ноги — toe, палець руки — finger.

warmup.q: The sun can be bad for your ___.
warmup.explain: Шкіра людини — skin (без -s). Leather — шкіра для сумок і взуття.

A.q: I've got a cold and I can't smell anything. My ___ is blocked.
She's wearing gold earrings in her ___.

B.q: I'm wearing sandals, so you can see my ___.
B.explain: Пальці ніг — toes. Fingers і thumbs — на руках.

B.q: My ___ are cold. I need warm socks.
B.explain: Множина від foot — feet. Шкарпетки — на ноги.

B.q: Hold up your ___ to show that everything is OK.
B.explain: Thumbs up — великий палець угору: «усе добре».

C.q: Turtles carry their homes on their ___.
C.explain: Черепаха носить панцир на спині — back.

C.q: Put your hand on your ___. Can you feel your heart?

C.explain: Шкіра тварини чи людини — skin. Leather — вироблена шкіра для речей.

D.q: Your ___ beats about seventy times a minute.
Your heart pumps ___ around your body.

topics: a family picnic in the park

example.title: A football Saturday
example.uk:
У суботу я грала у футбол з друзями. У першому таймі м'яч влучив мені в ніс, але зі мною все було гаразд.

Потім я впала і забила коліно. Мої ноги й руки були дуже брудні.

На останній хвилині я забила гол! Моє серце швидко билося.

Удома мама наклеїла пластир мені на коліно. Я втомилася, і в мене боліли ступні й спина. Я сходила в душ і помила голову. Потім я рано лягла спати.
example.en:
On Saturday I played football with my friends. In the first half, the ball hit my [[nose|a3]], but I was OK.

Then I fell and hurt my [[knee|b8]]. My [[legs|b7]] and [[hands|b5]] were very dirty.

In the last minute I scored a goal! My [[heart|d1]] was beating fast.

At home, Mum put a plaster on my knee. I was tired and my [[feet|b9]] and [[back|c4]] hurt. I had a shower and washed my [[hair|a1]]. Then I went to bed early.
